definitions.explanation: Resetting a device or storage medium to its original state; erasing all data and restoring default settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハードディスク→ハードディスク：06603_haadodisuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{初期化|しょきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{初期化|しょきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えます→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Data will be erased if you initialize.
You should factory reset your smartphone before selling it.

notes:
{初期化|しょきか} means to reset to initial/factory state, commonly used for electronic devices and storage media.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧: initial, early stage
- ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: -ization, making into

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初期化|しょきか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to initialize, to format
- {初期化|しょきか}⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: initialization screen
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧{初期化|しょきか}: factory reset
- {初期化|しょきか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧: initialization failed

WATCH OUT:
- {初期化|しょきか} deletes all data - always back up before initializing
- Used for troubleshooting or preparing devices for sale/transfer
